abstract: This archived methods artifact documents static construct formalization, rule-based evaluator validation, a failed v0.1 scientific execution, and a v0.2 provider preflight that correctly blocked scientific calls. It produced zero interpretable scientific outputs and does not validate Precision Illusion or any model-behavior claim.
